record.paper_title: New results and open problems on Toeplitz operators in Bergman spaces
record.original_question: Let T_a act on the Bergman space A^p of the unit disk, where the symbol a is matrix-valued. Find an index formula for Fredholm Toeplitz operators whose symbols lie in C(D) + H^∞(D), meaning sums of continuous matrix-valued functions on the closed disk and bounded analytic matrix-valued functions on the disk. The paper asks for this at least when p = 2, and also asks for the analogous index problem when the matrix-valued symbols belong to the Zhu class L^∞ ∩ VMO.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}$ denote the open unit disk in $\mathbb{C}$, and let $A^p = A^p(\mathbb{D})$ ($1 < p < \infty$) be the Bergman space of analytic functions on $\mathbb{D}$ that are $p$-integrable with respect to area measure. Let $P:L^p(\mathbb{D}) \to A^p$ be the Bergman projection. For a bounded measurable function $a$ on $\mathbb{D}$, the Toeplitz operator $T_a$ is defined on $A^p$ by $T_a f = P(a f)$. For an $N \times N$ matrix-valued symbol $a = (a_{ij})$ with entries in $L^\infty(\mathbb{D})$, $T_a$ acts coordinatewise on $(A^p)^N$.

Consider the symbol algebra $C(\overline{\mathbb{D}}) + H^\infty(\mathbb{D})$, consisting of sums of continuous functions on $\overline{\mathbb{D}}$ and bounded analytic functions on $\mathbb{D}$, and its $N \times N$ matrix-valued analogue $M_N(C(\overline{\mathbb{D}}) + H^\infty(\mathbb{D}))$. Also consider the Zhu class $L^\infty(\mathbb{D}) \cap \mathrm{VMO}_\partial(\mathbb{D})$ of bounded functions of vanishing mean oscillation (with respect to the Bergman metric), and its matrix-valued analogue.

Problems:
(a) For $p = 2$ (and more generally $1 < p < \infty$), find an explicit index formula for Fredholm block Toeplitz operators $T_a$ on $(A^p)^N$ whose matrix-valued symbols $a$ lie in $M_N(C(\overline{\mathbb{D}}) + H^\infty(\mathbb{D}))$, expressing $\mathrm{ind}(T_a)$ in terms of the symbol $a$.

(b) Find an analogous index formula for Fredholm block Toeplitz operators $T_a$ on $(A^p)^N$ whose matrix-valued symbols belong to $M_N(L^\infty(\mathbb{D}) \cap \mathrm{VMO}_\partial(\mathbb{D}))$.
artifact.status_search_result: Closely related index formulas exist: Douglas's index formula has been extended to block Toeplitz operators on the Bergman space of the ball, and Fredholm properties of Toeplitz operators on weighted Bergman spaces with matrix-valued symbols have been studied (Perälä–Virtanen, 2011). However, no source clearly establishing an explicit index formula for matrix-valued symbols in $C(\overline{\mathbb{D}}) + H^\infty(\mathbb{D})$ or in the Zhu class $L^\infty \cap \mathrm{VMO}_\partial$ on the disk Bergman space was found, so the precise status of the stated problems is not conclusively determined from the search.

status_evidence.title: The Index Formula of Douglas for Block Toeplitz Operators on the Bergman Space of the Ball
status_evidence.snippet: An index formula of Douglas type is established for block Toeplitz operators on the Bergman space of the unit ball.
status_evidence.claim: A Douglas-type index formula is known for block Toeplitz operators on the Bergman space of the ball, related to but not identical with the disk problem stated.

status_evidence.title: A note on the Fredholm properties of Toeplitz operators on weighted Bergman spaces with matrix-valued symbols
status_evidence.snippet: Fredholm properties of Toeplitz operators on weighted Bergman spaces with matrix-valued symbols are studied.
status_evidence.claim: Fredholm properties (but not necessarily an explicit index formula in the requested symbol classes) for matrix-valued Toeplitz operators on weighted Bergman spaces have been investigated.
